title: ReasonRec: A Reasoning-Augmented Multimodal Agent for Unified Recommendation
authors: Yihua Zhang, Mingfu Liang, Jiyan Yang, Rong Jin, Wen-Yen Chen, Yiping Han, Huayu Li, Buyun Zhang, Liang Luo, Frank Shyu, Luke Simon, Sijia Liu, Tianlong Chen, Xi Liu
org_display: Meta AI, Michigan State University, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
summary: ReasonRec 通过显式推理管道（Observe-Deliberate-Act）和不确定性引导的工具委派，在多模态推荐任务上取得超过 30% 的排名指标提升，同时降低了推理延迟。
